attempted_claim: Let PVI_theta be the sixth Painleve equation at fixed exponents theta=(1/9,2/9,4/9,1/3), reduced by an explicit Okamoto W(D4^(1)) word to an alcove-minimal representative with Sakai D4^(1) root ledger certifying it lies outside the Doran-Herfurtner-Movasati-Reiter elliptic geometric list. Decide: either (A) theta carries a genus-2 geometric solution, exhibited by an explicit hyperelliptic family C_s of genus 2 over P1\{0,1,t,inf}, its Picard-Fuchs equation, period map, and verified algebraic PVI solution polynomial, or (B) no genus-2 Picard-Fuchs pullback yields a solution at theta, proved by an explicit Zariski-density / Griffiths-transversality obstruction for the stated family type plus the reduced Backlund word and ledger ruling out descent to any elliptic geometric seed. A complete answer proves one alternative with the family or the obstruction fully explicit.
claim_type: genus-2 geometric origin existence at fixed exponents
decisive_failure: Neither horn of the target dichotomy could be closed: no explicit genus-2 family or solution polynomial was constructed, and the Sp(4) order/trace numerology lacks the proved embedding lemma and family-type specification needed for a rigorous obstruction; the wall resonance further blocks any descent ledger. The in-lane arithmetic screens are documented in output/artifacts/obstruction_check.py and output/WORKLOG.md but establish no theorem.
